Name: Socialize
Author: emrzeyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Socialize🌷 (Formerly Quick Festival Chat) [/b][/size][/center]
[center][i]Save your time, save your clicks, and spread the love all over the valley! [/i][/center]
[line]
[center]
[/center]
Hello fellow farmers! 🌻
Do you absolutely love the vibrant life in Pelican Town, but get a little exhausted running around trying to click on [i]every single person[/i] just to get those daily friendship points? I know I do!

[center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51760/51760-1788622825-276212332.gif[/img][/center]
[center]
[i]Just click the button and watch the magic happen![/i][/center]

Formerly known as [i]Quick Festival Chat[/i], [b]Socialize[/b] is a cozy little quality-of-life mod designed to make your daily routine stress-free. It adds a cute, smart button to your screen. With just one single click, the mod automatically counts you as having talked to the NPCs around you! It works perfectly on normal days, while exploring, or during crowded festivals.

[list]
[*]✨ [b]Instant Socializing:[/b] One click grants you the daily "talked to" friendship points for everyone in range. [/*]
[*]⚙️ [b]Fully Customizable (GMCM):[/b] Don't like the default settings? Change the button size, position, and visibility (Always, Festivals Only, or Normal Days Only) right from the in-game menu! [/*]
[*]📏 [b]Smart Radius:[/b] Set exactly how far your socializing reaches. Want to greet only nearby villagers? Set it to 5 tiles. Want to greet the whole map? Set it to 0! (Separate settings for festivals and normal days). [/*]
[*]💖 [b]Custom Visual Feedback:[/b] Watch adorable emotes pop up from nearby villagers! You can change the emote (Heart, Smile, Music Note, Sleep, etc.) and set how far away they appear. [/*]
[*]🧠 [b]Spoiler-Free & Immersive:[/b] The button automatically hides during cutscenes. Plus, it skips NPCs you haven't met yet (like the Wizard or Krobus) so you don't ruin the mystery! [/*]
[*]🌍 [b]Multi-Language Support:[/b] Automatically supports 14 languages right out of the box! [i](If you spot any weird translations in your language, please let me know in the comments so I can fix them!)[/i] [/*]
[/list][line]
[center]
[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51760/51760-1788619703-243003138.png[/img][/center]

Installing is super easy and quick! 🍓
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*][i](Highly Recommended)[/i] Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to change settings effortlessly in-game.[/*]
[*]Download this mod from the Files tab.[/*]
[*]Unzip the file and place the
[code]Socialize[/code]folder directly into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder. [i](If you have the old Quick Festival Chat folder, please delete it first!)[/i][/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI and enjoy![/*]
[/list][line]
[center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51760/51760-1788619574-1740869506.png[/img][/center]
[center]
[/center]
✔️ [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+:[/b] Fully tested and working perfectly with the latest updates.
✔️ [b]Multiplayer Friendly:[/b] Works wonderfully in co-op! It only affects the player who clicks the button, so you won't interrupt your friends' gameplay.
✔️ [b]100% Mod Compatible:[/b] Now uses vanilla friendship triggers! This means it works flawlessly with Friendship Multiplie[b]r[/b] mods and Custom NPCs.
✔️ [b]Safe to Add/Remove:[/b] You can safely add or remove this mod at any point during your playthrough without breaking your save files.


[line]
[center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51760/51760-1788619647-1424203906.png[/img][/center]

Thank you so much for stopping by and checking out my mod! I hope it makes your days in the valley just a little bit more relaxing and fun. ☕🍂

Created with love by [b]emrzeyy[/b]. A huge thanks to the amazing Stardew Valley modding community and the creators of SMAPI for making this possible! If you encounter any bugs, have translation fixes, or have suggestions, feel free to leave a comment in the Posts tab. Happy farming! 🚜✨
